assessment: Five-year test: the thesis mostly passes. The type argument rests on dated interviews from 2021 to 2025, across work, fame, privacy and the November 2024 election remark. Removing the newest material (the March 2026 ELLE France quotes and the Werwulf trailer) would leave the argument intact, though it would weaken the inward-trend counterweight slightly. The hook is a dated Nosferatu anecdote from Vanity Fair (November 2024) and doesn't depend on her current status. Dates are absolute almost everywhere. The Idol reporting is dated and attributed and carefully left unsettled. Review triggers exist for Werwulf, the Levinsons, the relationship, Chanel, the testimony gap and the 9takes Johnny Depp page. Main gaps: (1) the thesis-bearing interpretations C37/C44 are marked stable, the 2024 to 2026 inward trend (the most likely way the read breaks) has no inventoried claim, and C107's trigger doesn't reach the metadata; (2) the next-test section expires in about ten weeks; (3) a few status phrases (the relationship length, an absence claim, an FAQ trend, the "Rising Movie Star" category) are undated or untracked. On similarity: the tripped pair with Joseph Zada ("people and structure") and the top Arthur Mensch pair (a public-evidence hedge) are ordinary Type 6 vocabulary and a standard disclaimer. The arguments around them are specific to Depp (the paper-towel audition, the choreographed possession scenes, the election quote, the post-cancellation defense), so I don't report them as reuse. The triad primer and the "plain steps" Six paragraph are the most transferable text on the page, but they age fine. Risks: sensitive_allegations (The Idol production reporting, the 2016 allegation and the Depp v. Heard trial) and contested_typing (medium confidence, Type 4 close) both stand. No sources were reopened for this role. The findings check the draft against the evidence record's dates, durability labels and triggers.
